notes: Scored 12 concerns (C3, C5-C12, C17, C20, C21); C1, C2, C4, C13-C16, C18, C19 excluded by category. All fixed_in_v1 false: referee.json says round 1 matches arXiv v1, and spot checks of the paper text confirm the 40 GPa argument, D3 point group, 'strongly coupled case' typo, and ARPES Methods without geometry are present. Review A also matches two excluded concerns (C4 'strongly coupled case' typo; C19 MBE monolayer single/nodal gap via its literature-correlation point), so these are not listed as extras. C3 for B: B raises the SnS/1H proximity coupling (R3's part) but not the implausible 40 GPa pressure mechanism, so partly. C8 is partly for both: both raise a Gamma-vs-K multiband alternative for this paper's gaps but not the planar-junction argument about Ref. 35. C12 partly for A: it challenges model parameters and the quantitative gap comparison but not the DFT splitting comparison. Review A covers 5 raised and 2 partly of 12; Review B covers 1 raised and 2 partly. B explicitly says its lookalike library is outside this paper's domain.
